docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Buddhist form of the Rāma story, the Daśaratha-Jātaka, in Pāli with an English translation and notes by Fausbøll, with the other versions of the story compared (London, 1871). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Dasaratha-Jataka. Being the Buddhist story of King Rama. The original Pali text with a translation and notes by V. Fausbøll · Fausbøll, Michael Viggo, 1821-1908 · 1871, 44 scanned pages. Published 1871; Michael Viggo Fausbøll died 1908; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
